allow: PowerShell($token = \(Select-String -Path .env.local -Pattern '^MAILERLITE_API_KEY=\(.+\)$'\).Matches[0].Groups[1].Value; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://connect.mailerlite.com/api/groups?limit=25' -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer $token"; Accept = 'application/json' } -Method Get; $r.data | Select-Object id, name, active_count | Format-Table -AutoSize } catch { "ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell($token = \(Select-String -Path .env.local -Pattern '^MAILERLITE_API_KEY=\(.+\)$'\).Matches[0].Groups[1].Value; "token length: $\($token.Length\)"; try { $resp = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://connect.mailerlite.com/api/groups?limit=25' -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer $token"; Accept = 'application/json' } -Method Get -UseBasicParsing; "HTTP $\($resp.StatusCode\)"; $resp.Content } catch { "ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)"; if \($_.Exception.Response\) { "HTTP $\([int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode\)" } })

PowerShell($token = \(Select-String -Path .env.local -Pattern '^MAILERLITE_API_KEY=\(.+\)$'\).Matches[0].Groups[1].Value; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://connect.mailerlite.com/api/groups' -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer $token"; Accept = 'application/json'; 'Content-Type' = 'application/json' } -Method Post -Body '{"name":"Website signups"}'; "Created group id: $\($r.data.id\) name: $\($r.data.name\)" } catch { "ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell($token = \(Select-String -Path .env.local -Pattern '^MAILERLITE_API_KEY=\(.+\)$'\).Matches[0].Groups[1].Value; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://connect.mailerlite.com/api/subscribers/gauravkr2506%2Bnewsletter-test%40gmail.com' -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer $token"; Accept = 'application/json' } -Method Get; "email: $\($r.data.email\)  status: $\($r.data.status\)  groups: $\(\($r.data.groups | ForEach-Object { $_.name }\) -join ', '\)" } catch { "ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell($token = \(Select-String -Path .env.local -Pattern '^MAILERLITE_API_KEY=\(.+\)$'\).Matches[0].Groups[1].Value; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://connect.mailerlite.com/api/subscribers?limit=25' -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer $token"; Accept = 'application/json' } -Method Get; $r.data | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.email\)  status=$\($_.status\)  subscribed=$\($_.subscribed_at\)" } } catch { "ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })
